The new section is dated 2026-10-31, today's date in this environment, while the plan's status stamp stays at 2026-10-30. Before the first edit I'd check that I'm in the repo, since this environment reports no git repository.

<edit path="specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md">

Leave the fallback buffer at its current 64 MB in this task; make it larger only if a station's health log reports `BUFFER_FULL`, which no station has reported in the last year of logs. → item: 12-station-upload-retry — 2026-10-31
